items.title: Gallery View
items.subtitle: Browse an image subreddit as a grid, with a fullscreen viewer and media filters.

items.title: Open in Apollo
items.subtitle: Reddit links open in Apollo from Safari, however you sideloaded it.

items.title: Settings Search
items.subtitle: Search every setting from the top of the screen, or pull down to find it.

items.title: Subreddit Density
items.subtitle: Pick New, Classic, or Apollo's own header — Native brings the old one back.

items.title: Safer Poll Voting
items.subtitle: Pick an option, then confirm with Vote — Reddit's poll votes can't be undone.

items.title: Chat & Modmail Unlocked
items.subtitle: Every account can now choose modern Chat and Modmail instead of being locked in.

items.title: Smoother & Steadier
items.subtitle: Faster scrolling with translation on, and a fix for a crash while reading comments.
